Class LogPattern.AbstractLogPatternEntry

java.lang.Object
org.slb4j.LogPattern.AbstractLogPatternEntry
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogPattern.LogPatternEntry
Direct Known Subclasses:
LogPattern.ClassEntry, LogPattern.ColorEndEntry, LogPattern.ColorStartEntry, LogPattern.ExceptionEntry, LogPattern.FileEntry, LogPattern.LevelEntry, LogPattern.LineEntry, LogPattern.LocationEntry, LogPattern.LoggerEntry, LogPattern.MarkerEntry, LogPattern.MdcEntry, LogPattern.MessageEntry, LogPattern.MethodEntry, LogPattern.ThreadEntry
Enclosing class:
LogPattern
public abstract static class LogPattern.AbstractLogPatternEntry extends Object implements LogPattern.LogPatternEntry
An abstract representation of a log format entry, which specifies how individual components of a log message are formatted. This class implements the LogPattern.LogPatternEntry interface and provides foundational methods for formatting and alignment.

Subclasses must define the specific formatting behavior for different log components.

  • Constructor Details

    • AbstractLogPatternEntry

      protected AbstractLogPatternEntry(String prefix, int minWidth, int maxWidth, boolean leftAlign, boolean locationNeeded)
      Constructs an instance of the AbstractLogPatternEntry with the specified formatting parameters.
      Parameters:
      prefix - The prefix string that identifies the log component. This string will be included in the formatted log output.
      minWidth - The minimum width of the formatted output. If the formatted log component is shorter than this width, padding will be added to meet the minimum length.
      maxWidth - The maximum width of the formatted output. If the formatted log component is longer than this width, it will be truncated to the specified maximum length.
      leftAlign - A flag indicating whether the formatted output should be left-aligned. If true, padding will be added to the right of the formatted output; otherwise, padding will be added to the left.
      locationNeeded - A flag indicating whether this entry requires location information.

    • appendFormatted

      protected final void appendFormatted(Appendable app, @Nullable CharSequence value, boolean leftTruncate) throws IOException
      Appends a formatted string value to the provided Appendable, applying formatting rules such as truncation, padding, and alignment based on the specified class fields minWidth, maxWidth, and leftAlign. This method provides additional control over truncation direction.

      If the string value exceeds the maximum width, it will either be truncated from the left or the right, depending on the leftTruncate parameter. If the string value is shorter than the minimum width, padding will be added on either the left or right side, as determined by the alignment settings.

      Parameters:
      app - the Appendable to which the formatted value will be appended
      value - the string value to format and append; if null, it will be treated as an empty string
      leftTruncate - a flag indicating whether to truncate the string from the left when its length exceeds the maximum width
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs while appending to the Appendable instance

    • getLog4jPattern

      public String getLog4jPattern()
      Description copied from interface: LogPattern.LogPatternEntry
      Retrieves the Log4j-compatible pattern string used for formatting log entries. The pattern defines how various components of a log entry, such as the timestamp, log level, logger name, and message, are represented in the output.
      Specified by:
      getLog4jPattern in interface LogPattern.LogPatternEntry
      Returns:
      a string representing the Log4j-compatible pattern for formatting log entries.
